# UX and Architecture Requirements Checklist: Application Shell

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of Feature 001 UX,
accessibility, and frontend architecture requirements before task generation and implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [Application Shell specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is an author-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the author determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are shell responsibilities defined for every in-scope destination, including ownership of navigation, main content, titles, and hierarchy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements documented for every reusable pattern requested: headers, cards, tables, badges, buttons, forms, navigation, and user-facing states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the structural requirements for listing, form, wizard, hierarchy-selection, and dashboard compositions each documented without importing deferred business behavior? [Completeness, Plan §Shared Component Boundaries, Plan §Deferred Functionality]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements for page titles, descriptions, primary actions, back actions, breadcrumbs, and status placement complete for all page types that need them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-009, Contracts §UI Components]
- [ ] CHK005 Are all eight required route destinations and their primary-section ownership documented in one authoritative contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contracts §Navigation and Routes]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the boundary between a future-feature placeholder, a valid empty state, and an error state explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §PageStateDescriptor]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “persistent” navigation clarified for desktop, tablet, and mobile rather than implying the same visible treatment at every viewport? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Responsive Strategy]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the 375px, 768px, and 1440px representative acceptance widths clearly distinguished from implementation-level responsive breakpoints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Responsive Strategy]
- [ ] CHK009 Is “consistent spacing and typography” supported by a defined source of truth and review criteria rather than subjective visual judgment alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Theme Architecture]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the acceptable meaning of “safely truncated” defined, including how the full value remains available and accessible? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are active-navigation rules consistent between global Executions, execution details, and configuration-specific executions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004–FR-005, Contracts §Navigation and Routes]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the specification, plan, and route contract use the same canonical labels for Home, Monitoring Configurations, Executions, and Settings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Routing Architecture, Contracts §Navigation and Routes]
- [ ] CHK013 Are shared-component boundaries consistent with the rule that shared code contains no feature business decisions and features do not depend on one another’s internals? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Shared Component Boundaries, Plan §Feature Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the four visual references consistently subordinate to the constitution, specification, and plan, with mockup-only data and actions excluded? [Consistency, Plan §Visual Reference Use, Contracts §Visual Reference Map]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can the requirement that future features retain the shell unchanged be assessed with explicit stability criteria rather than interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the visual-consistency outcome tied to documented theme roles and allowed deviations so different reviewers can reach the same conclusion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Theme Architecture]
- [ ] CHK017 Are WCAG 2.2 Level AA requirements traceable to both automated and manual evidence, without treating automated scans as sufficient proof? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Testing Strategy]
- [ ] CHK018 Are navigation reachability and page-orientation criteria deterministic, objectively testable, and traceable across all eight canonical destinations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are primary-flow requirements complete for direct route entry, navigation between top-level areas, and entry into each nested destination? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK020 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for compact navigation, wrapped action groups, stacked panels, and localized table overflow? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Plan §Responsive Strategy]
- [ ] CHK021 Are exception and recovery requirements complete for unavailable content, invalid display identifiers, and recoverable versus non-recoverable errors? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are non-functional scenarios complete for keyboard-only use, screen-reader use, zoom/reflow, focus restoration, contrast, and non-color status cues? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011, Quickstart §WCAG 2.2 Level AA Review]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Does the specification define expected hierarchy and fallback wording when a route parameter is absent, malformed, or too long for its intended display? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Routing Architecture]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for viewport changes while compact navigation is open, including focus and state reconciliation expectations? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Responsive Strategy]
- [ ] CHK025 Are long labels, translated-length equivalents, validation messages, table values, and breadcrumb overflow addressed consistently even though localization is deferred? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Deferred Functionality]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are scoped performance requirements explicit about synchronous user-perceived navigation, prohibited artificial delays, and exclusion of formal benchmarking? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari support baseline explicit, including when browser-specific functionality requires a fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK028 Are security boundaries explicit that fixtures, route parameters, profile examples, and placeholder fields cannot contain or retain real credentials or sensitive values? [Coverage, Constitution §V, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Feature Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK029 Are accessibility requirements defined for every custom interaction introduced by wizard, tree, tabs, drawer, tables, and status components? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contracts §UI Components]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Is every planned dependency tied to an immediate Feature 001 need, with alternatives and maintenance impact documented? [Dependency, Constitution §XII, Research §Dependency Justification]
- [ ] CHK031 Are fixture isolation assumptions explicit enough to prevent presentation data from becoming shared domain data or a future API contract? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Presentation Fixtures]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the absence of backend, persistence, authentication, API, and GitLab dependencies stated consistently across the specification, plan, contracts, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Deferred Functionality, Quickstart §Scope Guard]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK033 Is the optional profile area requirement resolved clearly enough to prevent mock identity data from being mistaken for authentication scope? [Ambiguity, Plan §Shared Component Boundaries, Contracts §Visual Reference Map]
- [ ] CHK034 Are controls depicted in the references—such as run, download, clear-selection, search, and row actions—classified consistently as functional, disabled, absent, or preview-only for Feature 001? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Deferred Functionality, Contracts §Visual Reference Map]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
